sources.note: The highlighted mainland region denotes a simplified Republic of Korea/UN-held core area. Fronts omit isolated units, pockets, islands, and exact day-by-day territorial control. Coastline comes from the existing Native Natural Earth data. Changes show southward advance, northward counter-advance, withdrawal, and final stalemate in the historically correct order.
Existing project source geometry is reused byte for byte. Only new illustrative event polygons are clipped to its mainland coastline; native country geometry and boundaries remain unchanged.
